summary: Nightly roster sync reports success while silently dropping malformed rows
repro: Call sync_roster with a row that does not parse, e.g. ["1001,4", "not-a-row", "1003,3"]. It returns Ok { imported: 2 } and the caller reports a successful nightly sync. Districts discover missing students days later.
success_criteria: cargo test passes: a roster containing an unparseable row returns SyncOutcome::Failed carrying the zero-based index of the offending row and a non-empty reason; a clean roster still returns Ok with every row counted.
constraints: Do not change parse_row's signature or the shape of SyncOutcome. Keep the change minimal.
